title: CAQM mandates Installation of PTZ Cameras at Industries to ensure Comprehensive Real-time Monitoring of Fuel Use and Compliance in NCR
body_text:
The Commission for Air Quality Management in NCR and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) has issued an o rder mandating expansion of Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) cameras at industries in the National Capital Region (NCR) to ensure comprehensive real-time monitoring of fuel consumption and compliance with its d irections. The measure is aimed at strengthening vigilance, monitoring and compliance by industries, particularly in view of the adverse impact of industrial emissions on air quality in the NCR and adjoining areas, which assumes greater significance during the winter months.
In view of the persistent use of unapproved fuels, the Commission has expanded the areas to be captured by PTZ cameras at industrial units to make the coverage comprehensive and for effective monitoring and compliance. Apart from the locations of PTZ cameras already prescribed by CPCB, the Commission has directed that industries shall now also install additional PTZ cameras by 31.10.2026 , as per the following Standard Operating Procedure (SOP):
Location of Cameras
Cameras will be installed to capture all fuel storage areas. Cameras will be installed to capture all fuel charging points. In case of use of gas-based fuel, the gauge/ meter of the gas is to be captured by the camera.
Real Time Streaming
Real-time streaming of video feeds shall be made available to the servers of CPCB and respective SPCBs/ DPCC.
Power Source
All industries shall ensure that these cameras and the connectivity have adequate power backup.
The Order also mandates CPCB and the concerned SPCBs/ DPCC to develop portals and other necessary infrastructure to capture the real-time streaming of video feeds. This will facilitate remote monitoring of fuel-use practices by industries and help in ensuring the compliance of Commission’s Statutory Directions. The status of implementation of the said measures shall be submitted to the Commission by the concerned SPCBs/ DPCC by 01.11.2026 .
In the light of pollution caused by industrial emissions, the Commission had also prescribed a standard list of approved fuels for NCR for various applications, including industrial use. However, the Flying Squads of the Commission, during incognito inspections of industries across the NCR, have reported use of unapproved fuels in multiple instances. In view of the persistent use of unapproved fuels, the Commission has considered real-time monitoring of fuel consumption by industries necessary.
Considering the poor air quality in Delhi-NCR and with a view to ensure strict vigilance, monitoring and compliance through self-regulation, the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) had earlier directed installation of Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) cameras along with real-time Online Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems (OCEMS) by industries. The prescribed locations for installation of PTZ cameras include capturing the OCEMS port-hole as well as flue gas emissions from the stack in case of textile and food processing units having boilers and capturing fume extraction system areas and furnace feeding areas in metal units.
